## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      9 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 15.07.2026 - 25.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Monitor ePublications AR_, 25.09.2026, 2/5: "Won't open password protected files as of 9-26, prior to that usually stable. Known new issue, awaiting fix."
            2. _Aaren Arnolds_, 23.09.2026, 2/5: "The idea behind the app is excellent, but the app itself is not worth it. Typing is constantly laggy, and the documents often bug out and can't be edited unless you close then open them again. Text selecting tool is awful; it teleports from what you're trying to select onto text that needs to stay unselected. Buttons are desynced, I need to hit Bold in order to italicise, or Italics to underline. Formatting settings are kinda awkward and also laggy. Shame, considering it's the best option."
            3. _Jim_, 15.07.2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
<!--/ir-theme-->
